wholePhysicalScope: The city hall uses named multipolygon 7379169. The attached square tower is placed near its heritage point and its documented joint. The map inner ring is recorded as a map reference; source evidence establishes a square lower belfry with an octagonal upper stage.
lodDetails: Four detail levels retain the three-storey municipal front, rear wings and octagonal-stage belfry. Near levels show the balcony, limestone bays and pointed bell openings.
limitations: The principal mapped city hall outline and belfry heritage location guide the model. The square belfry base and exact roof intersections are reconstructed from the archive view and architectural records.
Secondary façade bays and roof volumes are estimates. The historical museum photo informs retained belfry fabric and proportions. The municipal street front uses the 2004 public-domain exterior.
The original street terrain is preserved. Finished threshold and attached surfaces are approximate at terrain resolution.
